DNSHijackWhitelist.description_en:
When a domain name (such as www.aliyun.com) is resolved, if the resolved IP address or CNAME is not in the DNS hijacking whitelist, the access fails or a non-Alibaba Cloud destination IP address is returned. If the resolved IP address or CNAME is in the DNS whitelist, no DNS hijacking is considered to have occurred.
Format: `Domain name:Matching rule`. Matching rules support IP addresses, IP address wildcards, subnet masks, and CNAMEs. You can specify multiple matching rules separated by vertical bars (|). Example: `www.aliyun.com:203.0.3.55|203.3.44.67`. This indicates that all IP addresses under the www.aliyun.com domain name except 203.0.3.55 and 203.3.44.67 are hijacked
DNSHijackWhitelist.description_zh:
域名（例如www.aliyun.com）解析时，解析出的IP地址或者CNAME不在DNS劫持白名单内，用户就会访问失败或者返回一个非Aliyun的目标IP；若解析结果中的IP或者CNAME在DNS白名单内，则会被认定为没有发生DNS劫持。

填写格式：`域名:匹配规则`。匹配规则支持IP、IP通配符、子网掩码和CNAME，可以填写多个匹配规则，多个匹配规则以竖线（|）隔开。例如：`www.aliyun.com:203.0.3.55|203.3.44.67`，表示www.aliyun.com域名下除203.0.3.55和203.3.44.67之外的其他IP都是被劫持的

PageTamper.description_en:
If elements other than those specified in the domain name settings appear on the monitored page, the page is considered tampered with. Common manifestations include pop-up ads, floating ads, and redirects.
Format: `Domain name:Element`. Elements support wildcards. You can specify multiple elements separated by vertical bars (|). Example: `www.aliyun.com:|/cc/bb/a.gif|/vv/bb/cc.jpg`. This indicates that all elements under the www.aliyun.com domain name except the base document, /cc/bb/a.gif, and /vv/bb/cc.jpg are considered page tampering
PageTamper.description_zh:

填写格式：`域名:元素`。元素支持填写通配符，可以填写多个元素，多个元素以竖线（|）隔开。例如：`www.aliyun.com:|/cc/bb/a.gif|/vv/bb/cc.jpg`，表示www.aliyun.com域名下除基础文档、/cc/bb/a.gif和/vv/bb/cc.jpg之外的其他元素都属于页面被篡改
